content:
Day One: Arrive in Tokyo.  
Seek lodging near Shinjuku.  
Visit the Meiji Shrine where spirits whisper.  
Wander Harajuku lanes and admire youthful garb.  
Feast upon sushi and sake at a humble izakaya.  

Day Two: Journey to Asakusa.  
Enter Senso-ji Temple.  
Purify thyself at the chozuya.  
Nakamise market offers trinkets and sweet ningyo-yaki.  
Ascend Tokyo Skytree for panoramic view.  

Day Three: Depart Tokyo by shinkansen to Kyoto.  
Arrive at noon.  
Check into ryokan with tatami mats.  
Stroll Gion district hoping to glimpse a geisha.  
Visit Kinkaku-ji the Golden Pavilion reflecting in pond.  

Day Four: Explore Arashiyama bamboo grove.  
Cross Togetsukyo Bridge.  
Visit Tenryu-ji Temple garden.
